description: This PHP script handles exporting requirements data in various formats (CSV, XML) for the TestLink open source test management tool. It includes functions for initializing arguments, setting up the GUI, checking user rights, and performing the export based on user input.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks user permissions for viewing requirements.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and sanitizes request arguments for export operation.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Sets up GUI parameters based on arguments and requirement specifications.

methods.name: doExport
methods.description: Performs the export of requirements data in the specified format and scope.
